products.title: Batch No. 9 |Salt Lake Zip | Milled Putter
products.body_html:
about this milled putter. 

We will email you to obtain the following information

  • Right or Left Hand
  • Length
  • Initials
  • Lie Angle
  • Sight Line

Expect an email within 24 hours of your purchase. Proceed with purchase and we will follow up with details post-purchase. Limited to one putter per purchase. 

The Salt Lake Zip is a zero torque fang design. The shaft aligns with the center of mass of the putter head. CNC milled putter out of 303 stainless steel; the Salt Lake Zip weighs 373 grams. A heavier head allowing for stability on the putting green. 

A different look than a traditional fang. With clean lines, the Salt Lake Zip measures 2.15 inches in depth. And yes, you can scoop up a golf ball with the Salt Lake Zip. 

who this milled putter is for. 
  • You want maximum control of the face at impact. 
  • Your distance control could improve. 
  • You may not always hit the center of the face on lag putts. 
  • You like the look of a classic putter with clean lines. 
  • You have a straight back, straight through, or slight arc in your putting stroke.
specs. 
  • 373 grams
  • 3 degrees of loft
  • 69, 70, 71 degree lie angle
  • 303 stainless steel
  • Aged copper plate
  • Iomic Hanna Golf 65 gram grip 
more info.
  • Batch No. 9
  • 18 putters in this batch

Each putter will include engraving of initials on the bottom and a #/18. As well as a limited release head cover made in the USA. And a limited release towel.

We will email you to get the correct initials engraved on each putter. If we are unable to get a response, we will engrave the first and last initial of the name on the order. 

These putters will continue to patina and age. 

Batch No. 9 of the limited release Salt Lake Zip will ship in 5 to 7 weeks. 

All sales are final. Returns and refunds will not be allowed due to customization. 

Hanna Golf putters are proudly milled in Iowa. 

Why is it named Salt Lake Zip? Here is the story behind the name.

products.title: Denver | Milled Putter
products.body_html:
about this putter.

Look different? It is. The Denver is a nontraditional milled putter mallet design. It checks in as a face-balanced putter with three sightlines for proper alignment. The two outer sightlines measure the width of a golf ball. CNC milled out of 303 stainless steel; the Denver weighs 370 grams. The double-bend shaft mounts directly in the head. Available in right and left hand. 

who this putter is for. 
  • Your distance control could improve.
  • You may not always hit the center of the face on lag putts. 
  • You like a putter that is a little heavier than the average putter.
  • You have a straight back, straight through, or slight arc in your putting stroke.
